existing_features.title: Create a multi-page React frontend with client-side routing supporting five pages: Home, About Coach, Training Programs, Pricing, and Contact. Include a persistent responsive navigation bar with the 'Volleyball Basic' brand name and links to all five pages, plus a footer with social media links and copyright information.

Build the Home page with: (1) a full-width hero section with the headline 'Volleyball Basic', a subheadline about professional volleyball coaching, a prominent 'Hire Me as Your Coach' CTA button, and a 'Starting at $200/month' pricing callout; (2) a brief services overview section showcasing the 6 training programs with icons; (3) a coach introduction teaser with Yash Bhardwaj's name and 5+ years experience; (4) a second CTA section urging visitors to sign up.

Build the About Coach page featuring: Coach Yash Bhardwaj's name and title, a section highlighting 5+ years of volleyball coaching experience, his mission statement ('Help players improve performance, jump higher, and avoid injuries'), a placeholder area for a coach photo, and a CTA directing visitors to the Training Programs or Contact page.

Build the Training Programs page with six individual service cards, each containing a title, short description, and key benefits for players. The six programs are: (1) Vertical Jump Training – explosive jump development for volleyball players; (2) Setter Specific Training – decision making, footwork, setting accuracy; (3) Attacker Specific Training – approach mechanics, arm swing, spike power; (4) Blocker Specific Training – timing, footwork, reading hitters; (5) Strength and Conditioning Training – sport-specific strength for volleyball; (6) Injury Recovery and Rehabilitation – safe return-to-play for volleyball athletes. Each card should have a 'Get Started' or 'Hire Me' CTA linking to the Contact page.

Build the Pricing page with a single Online Coaching Plan priced at $200/month. The plan card should list inclusions: personalized training plan, custom drills, and 1-on-1 guidance. Include a 'Get Started' CTA button linking to the Contact page. Add a brief FAQ or reassurance section (e.g., 'What's included', 'How it works') to reduce purchase friction.

Build the Contact page with: (1) a WhatsApp contact button linking to 'https://wa.me/919412574143' that opens WhatsApp chat; (2) a Facebook link to 'https://www.facebook.com/share/18PFxeeuyW/?mibextid=wwXIfr' labeled 'Yash Bhardwaj'; (3) an Instagram link to 'https://www.instagram.com/volleyball_basic?igsh=MWdjenViNm51N3d0aQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr' labeled 'VOLLEYBALL_BASIC'; (4) a contact inquiry form with fields for Name, Email, Phone (optional), Message, and a Submit button. Store submitted contact form messages in the backend.

Apply a cohesive modern sports coaching visual theme across the entire site. Use a bold color palette of deep navy blue and vibrant orange/gold as primary accent (volleyball-inspired), paired with clean sans-serif typography. The hero section should use a dynamic, high-contrast design with large headings. All pages should be fully mobile responsive with a clean grid-based layout. Use volleyball-relevant icons (e.g., volleyball, jump, strength) throughout. CTA buttons must be visually prominent with hover effects.
